marta: Heads-up — planning the datahouse schema migration next Tue. Need to lock the dual-write + backfill window. Proposal: 03:00-06:00 UTC. Who can own the deploy, smoke, and rollback readiness?
raj: I can own the deploy and run smoke checks. Will prepare checklist. Who's owning rollback script + verification?
camille: I can take rollback + canary. Recommend 30m canary on a subset (10% traffic) then ramp. Also will prepare pre/post smoke queries.
ali: DB team available for 03:00-06:00 UTC. Please ensure replica lag < 500ms at start — I'll monitor.
dinesh: I'll run the backfill with throttling. Plan is batched backfill with resumability. Example command we'll use in staging:```pg_update --batch-size=2000 --rate=50```
deploy-bot: Tentative slot requested by marta for 1932101111. Suggested calendar block: Tue 03:00-06:00 UTC. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/datahouse-migration
sre-bot: Oncall assigned: raj. Alert thresholds set: replica_lag>1s, p99_latency>500ms, replication_queue>1000. Auto-pause hook enabled for severe lag.
camille: PR merged to main (schema v2026.1). I'll validate canary DB with: `SELECT count(*) FROM new_table WHERE migrated IS NULL;` expecting 0.
marta: Ok locking 03:00-06:00 UTC Tue. Owners: raj (deploy+smoke), camille (rollback+canary), dinesh (backfill), ali (DB monitoring). Raj oncall. I'll update runbook and send calendar invite. :thumbsup:
raj: Will create the deploy checklist and add smoke commands (p50/p95 token counts, key SELECTs, worker queue depths). Note: rollback restore path ~20m if we need full revert.
ali: If replica lag spikes during backfill we pause and debug; backfill supports resume. +1 on 03:00 start.
dinesh: I'll prepare the batch plan and a small dry-run against canary cluster during the week prior.
deploy-bot: Deploy window confirmed. Reminder: run `deploy --cluster prod-datahouse --tag v2026.1 --dryrun` before the window, then full run when all checks green.
